scope: Completed absolute-time onset/activity and busy audit. No independently fitted onset shift/gain. Acceptance requires no clipping, matching silence/non-silence status and no worse absolute onset beyond one16us output quantum. Busy comparison is against a STATIC MAME source inventory, not a directly captured MAME busy edge; within1ms onset is reported separately. Fixed absolute20ms RMS-envelope/error and last activity offsets are descriptive, with no threshold substituted for the onset gate. No complete chip accuracy, state restore, native phase or synthesis claim.
